newsitem.title: USA: GDE Systems says in team getting USAF award.
newsitem.headline: GDE Systems says in team getting USAF award.

text.p: GDE Systems Inc said it is a member of the Raytheon Electronic Systems team which received a U.S. Air Force Electronic Systems Center award for the Command and Control Product Lines (CCPL) program.

GDE is a San Diego-based subsidiary of Tracor Inc PL is an initiative to reduce development time and costs associated with command and control acquisitions. The indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity prime contract has a potential value of $500 million over a five-year period, the company said.

"This contract award opens up a command and control technology line for our mission planning-focused business unit," said Dr. Terry A. Straeter, president of GDE Systems. "Our commitment is full life-cycle support -- the best end-to-end planning solution."
